Womens Memorial is a site honoring all military women - past, present and future. Which cemetery is it located in?
A. National Cemetery Webling
B. Arlington National Cemetery
C. Marietta National Cemetery
D. Barrancas National Cemetery
Correct answer: B. Arlington National Cemetery

Yorkshire pudding, a dish that originated in Yorkshire, England, is usually served with which of the following?
A. fish
B. strawberry jam
C. ice cream
D. roast meat
Correct answer: D. roast meat

You probably know that the Yellow River is a mighty river in China. What is its original name?
A. Yangtze
B. Chang Jiang
C. Huang He
D. Mekong
Correct answer: C. Huang He

Zoroastrianism is a religion which originated with which ancient civilization?
A. Babylonians
B. Persians
C. Sumerians
D. Greeks
Correct answer: B. Persians
